objective: Test on a newly generated untouched cohort whether the CG-4M measurement-reconciled coverage graph causes better partner-selection decisions and downstream mission outcomes than a genuinely evidence-using bundle-aware flat baseline under matched context budgets and an unchanged W4 outcome law.
interpretation_boundary: CG-5 tests an active evidence-acquisition architecture, not passive endogenous memory. Current members are deliberately probed until six independent reconciled events exist per agent/skill cell before the decision assay. A pass therefore supports graph-conditioned decision advantage after sufficient active measurement; it does not establish that sparse passive observations are sufficient.
scientific_boundary: Fresh W3 Field capsules are evaluator-hidden world state used only to instantiate individual capability, generate live probe outcomes, and compute oracle diagnostics. No historical W3 task/outcome/bid/pair-edge evidence is imported into context. Evidence retrieval never mutates per-agent beliefs. JointEnvironment receives individual states, mission/actions, and seed only; it receives no graph, evidence, relationship, or organization state.

fresh_source.source_generation_rule: The fresh source Fields are generated only after this protocol commit. Source generation and CG-5 evaluation occur in one dependency-gated workflow; the private source artifact is not inspected between generation and scoring.

society.turnover_rule: Identical to frozen CG-4: after the pre-turnover live probe phase, the four initial members with the highest observed canonical probe-success counts depart; ties resolve by agent_id; four deterministic reserve agents join.
society.supplemental_probe_rule: After turnover is fixed, append deterministic independent live probe events for current members only until every current agent/skill cell has six independent event identities. Supplemental probes cannot change the roster.
society.event_reconciliation: Collapse all complete observer reports sharing an event identity to one canonical event before capability estimation. Choose highest minimum claim confidence, then latest observed_at, then observer id. Count a canonical event exactly once.

context.membership_rule: Include the latest admissible active membership registry claim for each current member.
context.evidence_unit: A complete canonical event/participant/skill/outcome observation bundle represented by exactly three live-probe claims.
context.bundle_flat: After current membership, select complete canonical bundles matching either required skill in deterministic mission/event hash order. No candidate-skill coverage allocation and no evidence-score ranking.
context.revised_coverage_graph: After current membership, estimate current candidate/required-skill cells with the frozen Wilson estimator, rank cells by conservative score and support, balance lead/support retrieval, and retrieve complete supporting bundles without duplicating event identities.
context.shuffled_revised_graph: Use the same revised context volume and membership, but deterministically permute current-agent identities only on live evidence participant edges. Preserve event, skill, outcome, confidence, provenance, and membership so this ablation corrupts evidence topology rather than availability.
context.legacy_graph_active: Apply the original CG-4 graph compiler/estimator to the same actively measured claim stream as a historical architecture control.
context.passive_revised_graph: Apply the revised reconciler/estimator/retriever before supplemental probes are appended, isolating the effect of active measurement.
context.local_only_active: Current membership plus complete admissible bundles observed by the coordinator only, scored by the same frozen Wilson estimator.
context.matched_budget_rule: bundle_flat, revised_coverage_graph, and shuffled_revised_graph must contain equal mean context claim counts and equal complete-bundle counts; all remain at or below the 48-claim cap.

bootstrap.primary_contrast: revised_coverage_graph minus bundle_flat_active mean expected success

decision_rule: All gates are conjunctive. No threshold or architecture parameter may be changed after fresh source generation begins. A failed gate remains a CG-5 failure and the new cohort becomes permanently unblinded/exploratory.
